description: Orchestrator: analyse a floor-plan photo via MCP sampling, translate the structured vision result into a Pascal SceneGraph (site → building → level with walls and zones), optionally save it, and swap the bridge to the new scene. Requires host support for sampling.

defaultWallHeight.description: Default wall height. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

defaultWallThickness.description: Default wall thickness. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

image.description: Base64 or https URL of the floor-plan photo

name: photo_to_scene
title: Photo to Pascal scene
